title: Priced just under the bid limit
question: Do sample contracts sit just under the bid limit printed in the same contract, and do any two cover the same work?
finding: 4 sample contracts are priced within 10% under the bid limit their own text states, the closest at 99.7% of it (Pacific Northwest Enterprise, $109,000 against $109,300). Two Buildings and Grounds contracts cover the same door-access and intercom upkeep: Pacific Northwest Enterprise, $109,000 for 2023-2026, and Warman Security, $114,000 for 2024-2027; together $223,000, 195% of the limit.
how: Ratio = contract price / bid limit quoted in that contract's recitals ("currently, $..."). Scopes compared by the systems each contract names.
limits: Professional and special services may be contracted without bidding (Government Code section 53060, cited in the contracts), so a price under the limit is not by itself avoidance. Two vendors for the same equipment can be cover for different sites, a backup, or a hand-over between vendors. Multi-year totals are compared with a one-year limit, which is how the contracts present them.

rows.note: Both cover upkeep of Keri door-access systems, fobs and AiPhone intercoms; terms overlap from 2024-10-01 to 2026-06-30.

sources.t: San Francisco Unified School District, BoardDocs: contracts under the bid limit, 14 Oct 2025
